evidence.observation: Tube pressure was 3.027 Torr at a constant 100 sccm Ar setpoint.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.361 Torr despite essentially constant measured Ar flow, indicating a pressure/atmosphere-control anomaly.
Temperature is 749.8 °C against 750 °C setpoint; Ar is 99.5 sccm against 100 sccm setpoint.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; null O2 readings do not establish atmosphere purity.
